## Analysis

`sol_0012` is the only search to surpass the persistent 17-point local optimum, showing that large, partially occupied tensor supports are more promising than interval, symmetry, gap, or generic small-set families. The weaker exhaustive digit-product result indicates that merely introducing uniform carries is insufficient; useful collisions likely require nonuniform geometry. `sol_0014` also confirms the supposed `sol_0001` fallback was actually `sol_0000`, so parent metrics must be recomputed rather than asserted from labels.
